title: Lakers Legend Shaq Shoots His Shot At Australian Radio Host Jackie O [Watch]
htmlContent:
According to the Daily Mail, Australian Radio Host Jackie O has been happy being single since her 2018 divorce from ex-husband Lee Henderson.

However, that did not stop NBA Legend and Hall Of Famer Shaquille from shooting his shot. The Laker great was a guest on the The Kyle and Jackie O Show a head of a speaking tour in Australia.

“Is that the lovely Jackie O? I don’t want to talk to you, Kyle. I only want to talk to Jackie O,” O’Neal said, referring to Henderson’s co-host Kyle Sandilands. [H/t Jennale Moncelli of the NY Post].

“Bro, Jackie O is worldwide… I got here today, but I wanted to come and see the lovely, talented, gorgeous Jackie O.”

Henderson, meanwhile, appeared to relish in the moment, telling Shaq, “I love you. Oh my god. Favorite guest ever.”

“Kyle, when I move to Sydney it’s going to be the Shaq and Jackie O Show,” he said, to which Sandilands replied, “Come on and do it. I need a holiday, that would be great.”

“When I come to the studio I’m going to hug Jackie O and just push you out of your seat. You got that tough guy. Jackie O before you and that’s it,” O’Neal said.

Earlier this year Shaq partnered with Tampa Bay Buccaneers' wide receiver Julio Jones, and William Platt for a back to back school giveaway.
